remarks: Spacious, designer 1 bedroom apartment with sweeping southwest views! Come see this immaculate, bright & sunny corner apartment featuring 9' ceilings, hardwood floors & open entertainer's kitchen w/beautiful island overlooking the living space. French doors open to the very large bedroom featuring dressing area & updated full bath. Rent Includes Heat & Hot Water. Live the good life in the pulse of Stamford's downtown action steps to popular bars, restaurants, shopping, seasonal farmer's market and across the street from the popular Avon Theater. Garage parking is available for a fee in nearby Bedford-Forest-Broad Street Garage. This fabulous apartment is located in a meticulously maintained, mid-rise building. Come enjoy city life in popular downtown!
